_README: THE OUT-OF-ORDER REGISTER — input to db/queries/format_public_schema.js.
IF YOUR MIGRATION FILLS A RESERVED HOLE — a number BELOW the applied ladder tip —
ADD A RECORD HERE, IN THE SAME DELIVERY. That is F-SW.3's standing cure, ruled at
CE-32. It used to say 'write a line into PUBLIC_SCHEMA.md's header'; that header is
regenerated by the formatter on every run, so the line deleted itself and the cure
was fiction from the day it was written (F-SW.7). This file is the cure's new home:
it is hand-authored, committed, and NOT regenerated. The header is.
FIELDS. number is the migration's ladder number, and the ONLY structured field —
the filename is derived off db/migrations/ at render time, so it cannot go stale.
note, stale_for and state are VERBATIM MARKDOWN rendered into table cells unchanged.
Rows render in the order they appear here, not sorted: order is history.
THE FORMATTER ABORTS, WRITING NOTHING, IF: this file is missing or unparseable; a
record names a number with no .sql in db/migrations/; or a record's number is not
BELOW the ladder tip, which is what out-of-order MEANS.
REMOVE a record only when the regen it is owed has actually run and the body below
the header describes the table correctly. The row is a debt; regen pays it.
